src/core/hydration-sveltekit.ts::const o.why: Watches for SvelteKit's announcer during the wait for its root to mount; disconnected when it appears, at the cap, or by the cancel the startup host hands to the scope.

src/core/merge-need.ts::this.timer = set.why: The merge window's trailing flush; MergeNeed.destroy() clears it, and the scope owns that destroy.
